news.title: ‘Love & Hip Hop’ star 'Betty Idol' arrested, accused of $200K real estate scam
news.summary: Reality TV star Salomes Jackson ("Betty Idol"), known for her appearances on Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta, was arrested in Volusia County for her alleged role in a $196,000 real estate scam.

news.title: Police investigating shooting at DeKalb County home near elementary school
news.summary: Police have set up a large investigation in a DeKalb County neighborhood Friday morning in response to a reported shooting.

news.title: Body found in driveway in DeKalb County, investigation underway
news.summary: A death investigation is underway after a person was reportedly found dead in the driveway of a DeKalb County home Friday morning.

news.title: Man charged after equipment theft, I-75 chase
news.summary: A man faces multiple charges after Atlanta police say he stole landscaping equipment from a work truck and later ran across several lanes of Interstate 75 while trying to get away from officers.

news.title: Tree crashes onto multiple cars near Buckhead park
news.summary: A tree crashed onto multiple cars Thursday evening near Chastain Park, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Former Georgia sheriff candidate caught in Florida after months on the run
news.summary: Former Cobb County sheriff candidate and ex-deputy Antaney Hogan was arrested in Jacksonville after months on the run.

news.title: Sandy Springs massage employee arrested for sexual battery, police seeking additional victims
news.summary: Now, investigators are asking anyone who has received services from this man and believes they may have experienced inappropriate or unwanted contact.

news.title: 'Y'all got me sir': Video shows officers chasing suspected thief across I-75
news.summary: Police body-cam footage shows the suspect crossing active lanes of traffic on I-75 while police follow him.
